summaryJa: 2022年5月29–30日実施の空中ISRミッション報告。発信部隊は50ATKS、任務はATO E149による603 AOC支援のISRで、離陸は291355Z MAY22（シグネッラ空軍基地 LICZ）、着陸は301025Z MAY22、総飛行時間20時間30分、ステーション滞在時間は計14時間25分。ミッションではAIRHANDLER経由でSIGINTを収集し、IMINT（FMV含む）で東地中海/シリア海域（ラタキア、タルトゥース、バッセル・アル＝アサド飛行場等）を監視、39件程度のシリア海軍関連対象を収集・ターゲット開発。観測事項には艦艇（SLAVA、GORSHKOV級FFG（HULL 461）、UDALOY級DD（HULL 626、564）、SLAVA巡洋艦（HULL 055）等の出航・移動）や航空機（A-50U、IL-38駐機、IL-76活動、推定SU-27/35の着陸および離陸）等が含まれる。2147Zに1–3機の反応（うち1機はRFAF SU-30の可能性）、0117Zに小型UAPの可能性がある目撃を記録。0230Zに任務解除でRTB、FMVはDGS-INおよびDGS4で解析・利用。天候は影響なし。報告では「Intel Gap Filled?: No」とされている。
summaryEn: ISR mission report for 29–30 May 2022. Originator: 50ATKS, tasking ATO E149 in support of 603 AOC. Takeoff: 291355Z MAY22 from Sigonella (LICZ); landed 301025Z MAY22. Total mission time 20:30, on-station time reported as 14:25. The asset collected SIGINT via an airhandler and conducted IMINT/FMV over the Eastern Mediterranean and Syrian areas (including Latakia, Tartus, Bassel Al Assad airfield), collecting on approximately 39 Syrian navy-related targets and performing target development. Observations listed include naval movements (SLAVA, probable Gorshkov FFG hull 461, probable Udaloy DD hulls 626 and 564, SLAVA/CG hull 055, etc.) and aircraft activity (A-50U and IL-38 parked, IL-76 active, a probable SU-27/35 landing and a probable SU-27/35 takeoff). At 2147Z the aircraft was reacted to by 1–3 aircraft, including one possible RFAF SU-30; at 0117Z one possible small UAP was observed. The asset was cleared off tasking and RTB at 0230Z; FMV was exploited by DGS-IN and DGS4. Weather was not a factor. The report indicates intel gaps were not filled.
